pf.visit.notes: The reader's notes stay with the reader, never in Rosie. Rosie keeps only that the reading happened, its time and its length.

pf.money.before: Studio: a single reading takes nothing when booked; a video or phone reading saves a card for the $20 late-cancel fee; the six-reading package is paid in full when booked. Home: nothing taken; a card is saved for the $89 visit fee where the owner turns it on; a group circle takes a $160 deposit.
pf.money.after: Studio: paid at the desk, or the saved card charged when the reader texts DONE (video or phone). Home: Rosie texts the bill after DONE.
pf.money.packages: Paid in full when booked; each reading uses one. A cancel in time puts the reading back. A late cancel or a no-show may use it up, only with the owner's yes; silence keeps it on the package. Readings left when a client stops: refunded as the agreement says.
pf.money.plans: Not used: no monthly plan. A repeat reading is booked one at a time.
pf.money.fees: One fee per booking: the largest of its services' fees, counted only where a card is saved or money was paid now. Studio $20 ($40 for the full reading day); home $89. Only where the owner turns it on and says so.
pf.money.the reader cancels: A new time or a full refund, never a fee.
pf.money.deposit cap: From the state form; no deposit is taken for a single reading.
pf.money.tips: None by default: the owner's tip line stays off.
pf.money.tax: None by default; the state form says if readings are taxed there.
pf.money.rosfield: The $2 per confirmed booking applies to every profession (D97), counted at check-in. A package booked as one series counts once.

pf.staff.licenses: None needed by default. A credential is the reader's own word, shown only as stated.
pf.staff.supervision: None. An assistant may run the desk, but never reads.
pf.staff.who OKs what: The owner (Sam) alone: fees, refunds, group circles over the limit, and any price made for one client. Pat, the office manager, OKs prices over $500.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Only another reader, offered by name and picked by the client. A reader is never swapped because nobody answered.

pf.rules.reading agreement: Signed on the secure page before the first paid reading: scope, confidentiality and its limits, fees, the cancel window, and that either side may end it.
pf.rules.scope text: The reader's own scope text shows at booking: a reading is for reflection and entertainment, not therapy, medical, legal or money advice.
pf.rules.words used: Rosie never calls a reading 'therapy', 'counseling', 'healing' or 'medical' care, where the state's rules limit those words.
pf.rules.named or listed: A named reader shows only their own times. With nobody named, the studio's readers are listed with no ranking.
pf.rules.fear-based add-ons: Never offered: no cleansing, curse removal, 'bad energy' fix or extra reading is sold because someone is afraid. Only the studio's own price list is offered, each at its own price, with the client's own yes.
pf.rules.host pays: Switch, on by default: the host sees attendance and the bill only.
pf.rules.right to cancel: A package sold at the client's place comes with a written right to cancel, where the state's rules require it. A reading given at a visit has no cancel period.
pf.rules.records: Booking records 7 years. Reading notes stay with the reader, never in Rosie.
pf.rules.status: Draft: the owner's own settings finish it.

matter_most.asks for therapy or a diagnosis: Told plainly what a reading is; the person picks. No judgment.
matter_most.crisis words: 988 or 911 at once. The AI never counsels. A booking stays as it is.
matter_most.a fear-based push to pay: Nothing is booked or sold; only the price list is shown.
matter_most.advice by text: Never given. It waits for the reader, with a sooner time offered.
matter_most.a late client: The time left, at the same price.

matter_most.a host pays: The host sees only the date, length and the bill.
matter_most.a work phone: Only the way the client picks.
